app.title: A Partial Evaluator for C
app.description: A partial evaluator for the C language that performs compile‑time optimizations and code specialization
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and run the build script to install tempo
Compile a small C program with tempo and verify that the output matches the original program
Use tempo to specialize a function with constant arguments and check that the generated code contains the inlined constants
Measure compile time reduction on a benchmark C project
